notes.title: Patchnotes F2P preparations
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The DLC is finally finished and the patch just went live. Everyone who has bought or will buy the game untill it goes into F2P state will automatically get the DLC assigned to their account. 

The shift to F2P will be done as soon as possible!

DLC Content:

The DLC contains hats and skins for you character and let's you customize it to not look like everyone else.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30412463/6344782f699cf2ec25ee3aa15480b52a8b2495e1.png[/img]

notes.title: Patchnotes 09 / 30 / 17
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Today is patch-day!

It contains the new locomotion system that allows you to dash when double tapping sprint and a reduced base movement speed. This regains more control of the character and retains quick locomotion around the map once you've mastered the dashing.

It also contains a reworked jumping system that is more forgiving and will prevent falling from edges when pressing jump too late.

Have fun and good luck everyone!

notes.title: Hotfix 09 / 17 / 17
notes.content: Just deployed a hot fix for an issue that resulted in double map loadings in practice mode when you returned from hosting a multiplayer game.

notes.title: Patchnotes 09 / 16 / 17
notes.content:
Greetings everyone! There's a new patch!

[list]
    [*]increased player movement speed
    [*]decreased the speed reduction when wielding a weapon
    [*]the player now has a trail effect when sprinting
    [*]adjusted the endscreen window for people winning the game so that you will not move around anymore
    [*]the lobby chat- and endscreen chat -input field now doesn't deselect after sending a message
    [*]when killed you now know on which place you landed
    [*]endscreen now contains a counter for how many players are still alive
[/list]

notes.title: Patchnotes 09 / 14 / 17
notes.content:
Greetings everyone! It's that time again. Here are the notes for this patch!

- two new map themes, medieval and asian inspired themes (in a more humorous way though)  Shown in the two images below.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30412463/78ad05a8933a59ef274c5ec2b3782b7929d6b8b8.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30412463/4e2ce1363c12622ed31299300842d5c147dd94f0.png[/img]

- two new weapons, a butcher knife and a pistol crossbow

- item highlighting reworked again, now works as before when directly looking at but way more performant than in the first iteration

- projectiles shot by weapons now also inherit the player's velocity which allows for some more tactitcal play in the sense that the projectiles fly faster when charging someone when shooting

- added footstep sounds for other players so you can eventually hear people approaching you

- endgame chat

- fixed gun sounds on orther players

- fixed an issue where you could fire weapons without ammo

notes.title: Patchnotes 09 / 06 / 17
notes.content:
Hello everybody! Today's the day! New patch is here!

The new patch contains the following:

A practice mode available through the main menu where you can practice your shooting skills on floating dummies on a selected map (singleplayer)

A major rebalancing of weapons to lengthen the playtime of the match a bit and make them less risky and more fun in the sense that they have more ammunition, less damage and lesser risk of backfiring now.

The first two achievements made it in as well. They're really easy achievements to start of with, there will be more challenging ones in the future.

You're standing now closer to items/weapons in boxes when looting since the player can now walk through the boxes (projectiles and thrown items can't) This is to help any stucking looting issues that have been there before.

The weapons and boxes highlighting is now done in a per range basis which means if they're in reach of the player they will be highlighted regardless of looking at them, this is to gain some performance and prevent some hiccups we've experienced before.

The player names in the lobby are now longer and wont be cut too short.

Added the "Sprint" key to the control sheet on the main menu.

Fixed an issue with the signal torch not burning for the other players when picking it up yourself.

We hope this will bring quite the enjoyment! And happy looting and shooting!

notes.title: Upcoming Patch
notes.content:
The upcoming patch will contain quite some stuff.

- Practice Mode (Singleplayer, as mentioned in the previous announcement)
- Item rebalancing (Less risky, less damage, more ammunition, prolonged battles)
- Achievements
- Edited post processing effects
- Adjusted box collision to enable quicker and more direct looting
- Reworked the highlighting system of items/weapons in an optimizing manner

There is no ETA yet but it wont take too long to finish it up (most likely by friday)



After that patch the main focus will be on:

- enabling endgame chat
- adding the ability to rematch in private/friends only lobbies
- option for visible name tags above players
- indicator for how many players are remaining
- adding a display for the achieved place after getting killed

notes.title: Patchnotes 09 / 03 / 17
notes.content:
8 new weapons have been added ( 4x Firearms, 3x Throwing, 1x Melee )

8 new Masks have been added

Map selection dropdown default is now "Random"

The lobby browser is now version dependent to prevent unnecessary errors during patching phases (you can only find games hosted by clients with the same version)
